commands.name: recall-suite-native
commands.run:
out=$(HOME="$(mktemp -d)" bash claude/skills/repo-recall/scripts/tests/recall_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -E 'file_mode|passed'; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'ok   file_mode reads dir mode' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'ok   file_mode reads file mode'

commands.name: recall-suite-gnu-stat
commands.run: if [ "$(uname)" = Linux ]; then g=$(command -v stat); else g=$(command -v gstat) || { echo "[X] gstat (Homebrew coreutils) missing; cannot emulate GNU stat"; exit 1; }; fi; d=$(mktemp -d); ln -s "$g" "$d/stat"; out=$(PATH="$d:$PATH" HOME="$(mktemp -d)" bash claude/skills/repo-recall/scripts/tests/recall_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E 'file_mode|mode 700|mode 600|passed'; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'ok   file_mode reads file mode'

commands.name: probe-guard-gnu-shaped-junk
commands.run:
d=$(mktemp -d); printf '#!/bin/sh
printf "  File: junk\nBlock size: junk\n"
exit 0
' > "$d/stat"; chmod +x "$d/stat"; out=$(PATH="$d:$PATH" HOME="$(mktemp -d)" bash claude/skills/repo-recall/scripts/tests/recall_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -E 'file_mode|passed'; [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'MODE-PROBE-BROKEN' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'FAIL file_mode reads dir mode' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'FAIL file_mode reads file mode' && ! printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'Block size'

commands.name: probe-guard-bsd-shaped-junk
commands.run:
d=$(mktemp -d); printf '#!/bin/sh
[ "$1" = -c ] && { echo "stat: illegal option -- c" >&2; exit 1; }
printf "  File: junk\nBlock size: junk\n"
exit 0
' > "$d/stat"; chmod +x "$d/stat"; out=$(PATH="$d:$PATH" HOME="$(mktemp -d)" bash claude/skills/repo-recall/scripts/tests/recall_test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -E 'file_mode|passed'; [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'MODE-PROBE-BROKEN' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'FAIL file_mode reads dir mode' && printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'FAIL file_mode reads file mode' && ! printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -q 'Block size'
